SELECT Reservations.Number AS RefNumber, Reservations.Date AS RefDate, Reservations.Hotel AS Hotel, Reservations.ResourceTariff.Code AS ResourceTariffCode, Reservations.ResourceTariff AS ResourceTariff, Reservations.ClientType.Code AS ClientTypeCode, Reservations.ClientType AS ClientType, Reservations.SourceOfBusiness.Code AS SourceOfBusinessCode, Reservations.SourceOfBusiness AS SourceOfBusiness, Reservations.MarketingCode.Code AS MarketingCodeCode, Reservations.MarketingCode AS MarketingCode, Reservations.Client AS Guest, Reservations.Client.FullName AS ClientFullName, Reservations.Client.Citizenship.ISOCode AS ClientCitizenshipISOCode, CASE WHEN Reservations.Client.Citizenship = Reservations.Hotel.Citizenship THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS ClientIsLocalCitizen, Reservations.Client.DateOfBirth AS ClientDateOfBirth, CASE WHEN ISNULL(Reservations.Client.DateOfBirth, DATETIME(1, 1, 1)) > DATETIME(1, 1, 1) THEN CASE WHEN YEAR(Reservations.DateTimeFrom) = YEAR(Reservations.DateTimeTo) THEN CASE WHEN MONTH(Reservations.Client.DateOfBirth) * 100 + DAY(Reservations.Client.DateOfBirth) >= MONTH(Reservations.DateTimeFrom) * 100 + DAY(Reservations.DateTimeFrom) AND MONTH(Reservations.Client.DateOfBirth) * 100 + DAY(Reservations.Client.DateOfBirth) <= MONTH(Reservations.DateTimeTo) * 100 + DAY(Reservations.DateTimeTo) THEN 55 ELSE 0 END ELSE CASE WHEN MONTH(Reservations.Client.DateOfBirth) * 100 + DAY(Reservations.Client.DateOfBirth) >= MONTH(Reservations.DateTimeFrom) * 100 + DAY(Reservations.DateTimeFrom) AND MONTH(Reservations.Client.DateOfBirth) * 100 + DAY(Reservations.Client.DateOfBirth) <= 1231 THEN 55 WHEN MONTH(Reservations.Client.DateOfBirth) * 100 + DAY(Reservations.Client.DateOfBirth) <= MONTH(Reservations.DateTimeTo) * 100 + DAY(Reservations.DateTimeTo) AND MONTH(Reservations.Client.DateOfBirth) * 100 + DAY(Reservations.Client.DateOfBirth) >= 101 THEN 55 ELSE 0 END END ELSE 0 END AS BirthDateIcon, Reservations.Client.Age AS ClientAge, Reservations.Client.AgeRange AS ClientAgeRange, CASE WHEN Reservations.Client.Sex = VALUE(Enum.Sex.Male) THEN 26 WHEN Reservations.Client.Sex = VALUE(Enum.Sex.Female) THEN 27 ELSE 0 END AS ClientSexIcon, CASE WHEN Reservations.Phone <> "" THEN Reservations.Phone ELSE Reservations.Client.Phone END AS Phone, CASE WHEN Reservations.EMail <> "" THEN Reservations.EMail ELSE Reservations.Client.EMail END AS EMail, Reservations.GuestGroup AS GuestGroup, Reservations.GuestGroup.Code AS GuestGroupCode, Reservations.Resource AS Resource, Reservations.ResourceType AS ResourceType, Reservations.ResourceType.Code AS ResourceTypeCode, Reservations.ResourceReservationStatus AS ReservationStatus, Reservations.ResourceReservationStatus.Code AS ReservationStatusCode, Reservations.ResourceReservationStatus.Description AS ReservationStatusDescription, Reservations.GuaranteeType AS GuaranteeType, Reservations.GuaranteeType.Code AS GuaranteeTypeCode, Reservations.Customer AS Customer, Reservations.Contract AS Contract, Reservations.Agent AS Agent, Reservations.ChargingFolio AS ChargingFolio, Reservations.ChargingFolio.Number AS ChargingFolioNumber, Reservations.GuestGroup.Allotment AS Allotment, Reservations.Client.DiscountCard.DiscountType AS DiscountCardDiscountType, Reservations.Client.IsInWhiteList AS IsInWhiteList, Reservations.Client.MilitaryRank AS Rank, BEGINOFPERIOD(Reservations.DateTimeFrom, DAY) AS AccountingDate, Reservations.DateTimeFrom AS DateTimeFrom, Reservations.Duration AS Duration, Reservations.DateTimeTo AS DateTimeTo, Reservations.ServicePackage AS ServicePackage, Reservations.PlannedPaymentMethod AS PlannedPaymentMethod, Reservations.PlannedPaymentMethod.Code AS PlannedPaymentMethodCode, Reservations.Remarks AS Remarks, Reservations.Car AS Car, Reservations.NumberOfPersons AS NumberOfPersons, Reservations.Resource.SortCode AS ResourceSortCode, 0 AS ClientSumBalance, 0 AS CustomerSumBalance, 0 AS ClientLimitBalance, Reservations.ReportingCurrency AS FolioCurrency, CASE WHEN Reservations.ResourceReservationStatus.IsActive THEN CASE WHEN Reservations.ResourceReservationStatus.IsGuaranteed THEN 44 WHEN Reservations.ResourceReservationStatus.ServicesAreDelivered THEN 45 ELSE 42 END ELSE 43 END AS IDIconStatus, Reservations.Ref AS Ref, Reservations.EventActivity AS EventActivity, Reservations.Company AS Company, Reservations.Author AS Author, Reservations.Posted AS Posted, Reservations.DeletionMark AS DeletionMark, ReservationStatusChangeHistoryRecords.Period AS ReservationStatusSetTime, &qBalancesAreVisible AS BalancesAreVisible FROM Document.ResourceReservation AS Reservations LEFT JOIN InformationRegister.ResourceReservationChangeHistory.SliceLast( &qEndOfDate, &qSearchByChangeDate AND (NOT &qHotelIsFilled OR &qHotelIsFilled AND Hotel IN HIERARCHY (&qHotel))) AS ReservationLastState ON (&qSearchByChangeDate) AND Reservations.Ref = ReservationLastState.ResourceReservation LEFT JOIN InformationRegister.ResourceReservationChangeHistory AS ReservationChangeHistoryRecord ON (&qSearchByChangeDate) AND (ReservationChangeHistoryRecord.ResourceReservation = Reservations.Ref) AND (ReservationChangeHistoryRecord.Period = ReservationLastState.Period) LEFT JOIN (SELECT ReservationStatusChangeHistoryRecords.ResourceReservation AS ResourceReservation, ReservationStatusChangeHistoryRecords.ResourceReservationStatus AS ResourceReservationStatus, MAX(ReservationStatusChangeHistoryRecords.Period) AS Period FROM InformationRegister.ResourceReservationChangeHistory AS ReservationStatusChangeHistoryRecords
GROUP BY ReservationStatusChangeHistoryRecords.ResourceReservation, ReservationStatusChangeHistoryRecords.ResourceReservationStatus) AS ReservationStatusChangeHistoryRecords ON (ReservationStatusChangeHistoryRecords.ResourceReservation = Reservations.Ref) AND (ReservationStatusChangeHistoryRecords.ResourceReservationStatus = Reservations.ResourceReservationStatus) WHERE (&qShowAll OR NOT &qShowAll AND NOT &qShowNotPostedOnly AND &qShowActiveOnly AND Reservations.Posted AND (Reservations.ResourceReservationStatus.IsActive OR Reservations.ResourceReservationStatus.ServicesAreDelivered) OR NOT &qShowAll AND &qShowNotPostedOnly AND NOT Reservations.Posted OR NOT &qShowAll AND NOT &qShowNotPostedOnly AND NOT &qShowActiveOnly AND Reservations.Posted) AND (NOT &qHotelIsFilled OR &qHotelIsFilled AND Reservations.Hotel IN HIERARCHY (&qHotel)) AND CASE WHEN &qInPeriod THEN &qSearchByDateFrom AND &qDateIsFilled AND BEGINOFPERIOD(Reservations.DateTimeFrom, DAY) >= &qDate AND BEGINOFPERIOD(Reservations.DateTimeFrom, DAY) <= &qDateTo OR &qSearchByStayDate AND &qDateIsFilled AND BEGINOFPERIOD(Reservations.DateTimeTo, DAY) >= &qDate AND BEGINOFPERIOD(Reservations.DateTimeFrom, DAY) <= &qDateTo OR &qSearchByDateTo AND &qDateIsFilled AND BEGINOFPERIOD(Reservations.DateTimeTo, DAY) >= &qDate AND BEGINOFPERIOD(Reservations.DateTimeTo, DAY) <= &qDateTo OR &qSearchByCreateDate AND &qDateIsFilled AND BEGINOFPERIOD(Reservations.Date, DAY) >= &qDate AND BEGINOFPERIOD(Reservations.Date, DAY) <= &qDateTo OR &qSearchByChangeDate AND &qDateIsFilled AND BEGINOFPERIOD(ReservationLastState.Period, DAY) >= &qDate AND BEGINOFPERIOD(ReservationLastState.Period, DAY) <= &qDateTo OR &qSearchByStatusChangeDate AND &qDateIsFilled AND BEGINOFPERIOD(ReservationStatusChangeHistoryRecords.Period, DAY) >= &qDate AND BEGINOFPERIOD(ReservationStatusChangeHistoryRecords.Period, DAY) <= &qDateTo OR NOT &qDateIsFilled ELSE &qSearchByDateFrom AND &qDateIsFilled AND BEGINOFPERIOD(Reservations.DateTimeFrom, DAY) = &qDate OR &qSearchByStayDate AND &qDateIsFilled AND BEGINOFPERIOD(Reservations.DateTimeFrom, DAY) <= &qDate AND BEGINOFPERIOD(Reservations.DateTimeTo, DAY) >= &qDate OR &qSearchByDateTo AND &qDateIsFilled AND BEGINOFPERIOD(Reservations.DateTimeTo, DAY) = &qDate OR &qSearchByCreateDate AND &qDateIsFilled AND BEGINOFPERIOD(Reservations.Date, DAY) = &qDate OR &qSearchByChangeDate AND &qDateIsFilled AND BEGINOFPERIOD(ReservationLastState.Period, DAY) = &qDate OR &qSearchByStatusChangeDate AND &qDateIsFilled AND BEGINOFPERIOD(ReservationStatusChangeHistoryRecords.Period, DAY) = &qDate OR NOT &qDateIsFilled END AND (NOT &qShowAll AND NOT &qShowNotPostedOnly AND NOT &qShowActiveOnly AND (&qSearchByChangeDate AND ReservationLastState.ResourceReservationStatus = &qResourceReservationStatus OR NOT &qSearchByChangeDate AND Reservations.ResourceReservationStatus = &qResourceReservationStatus) OR &qShowAll OR &qShowNotPostedOnly OR &qShowActiveOnly) AND (NOT &qAuthorIsFilled OR &qAuthorIsFilled AND (&qSearchByChangeDate AND ReservationChangeHistoryRecord.User = &qAuthor OR NOT &qSearchByChangeDate AND Reservations.Author = &qAuthor)) AND (NOT &qGuestGroupIsFilled OR &qGuestGroupIsFilled AND Reservations.GuestGroup = &qGuestGroup) AND (NOT &qCustomerIsFilled OR &qCustomerIsFilled AND Reservations.Customer IN HIERARCHY (&qCustomer)) AND (NOT &qContractIsFilled OR &qContractIsFilled AND Reservations.Contract = &qContract) AND (NOT &qAgentIsFilled OR &qAgentIsFilled AND Reservations.Agent IN HIERARCHY (&qAgent)) AND (NOT &qAllotmentIsFilled OR &qAllotmentIsFilled AND Reservations.GuestGroup.Allotment IN HIERARCHY (&qAllotment)) AND (NOT &qResourceTariffIsFilled OR &qResourceTariffIsFilled AND Reservations.ResourceTariff IN HIERARCHY (&qResourceTariff)) AND (NOT &qActivityIsFilled OR &qActivityIsFilled AND (Reservations.EventActivity = &qActivity OR Reservations.Ref IN (SELECT ReservationServices.Ref FROM Document.ResourceReservation.Services AS ReservationServices WHERE ReservationServices.EventActivity = &qActivity AND ReservationServices.Ref.Posted))) AND (NOT &qResourceIsFilled OR &qResourceIsFilled AND (Reservations.Resource = &qResource OR Reservations.Ref IN (SELECT ReservationServices.Ref FROM Document.ResourceReservation.Services AS ReservationServices WHERE ReservationServices.ServiceResource = &qResource AND ReservationServices.Ref.Posted))) AND (NOT &qResourceTypeIsFilled OR &qResourceTypeIsFilled AND (Reservations.ResourceType IN HIERARCHY (&qResourceType) OR Reservations.Ref IN (SELECT ReservationServices.Ref FROM Document.ResourceReservation.Services AS ReservationServices WHERE ReservationServices.ServiceResource <> VALUE(Catalog.Resources.EmptyRef) AND ReservationServices.ServiceResource.Owner IN HIERARCHY (&qResourceType) AND ReservationServices.Ref.Posted))) AND (NOT &qClientIsFilled OR &qClientIsFilled AND Reservations.Client = &qClient)

Settings.QueryText: SELECT DocumentProformaInvoice.Ref AS Ref, DocumentProformaInvoice.DeletionMark AS DeletionMark, DocumentProformaInvoice.Number AS Number, DocumentProformaInvoice.Date AS Date, DocumentProformaInvoice.Posted AS Posted, DocumentProformaInvoice.ParentDoc AS ParentDoc, DocumentProformaInvoice.Hotel AS Hotel, DocumentProformaInvoice.Company AS Company, DocumentProformaInvoice.BankAccount AS BankAccount, DocumentProformaInvoice.AccountingCustomer AS AccountingCustomer, DocumentProformaInvoice.AccountingContract AS AccountingContract, DocumentProformaInvoice.GuestGroup AS GuestGroup, DocumentProformaInvoice.ContactPerson AS ContactPerson, DocumentProformaInvoice.Phone AS Phone, DocumentProformaInvoice.Fax AS Fax, DocumentProformaInvoice.EMail AS EMail, DocumentProformaInvoice.Sum AS Sum, DocumentProformaInvoice.VATSum AS VATSum, DocumentProformaInvoice.ExchangeRateDate AS ExchangeRateDate, DocumentProformaInvoice.AccountingCurrency AS AccountingCurrency, DocumentProformaInvoice.AccountingCurrencyExchangeRate AS AccountingCurrencyExchangeRate, DocumentProformaInvoice.Remarks AS Remarks, DocumentProformaInvoice.PrintWithCompanyStamp AS PrintWithCompanyStamp, DocumentProformaInvoice.ExternalCode AS ExternalCode, DocumentProformaInvoice.ExtraInvoice AS ExtraInvoice, DocumentProformaInvoice.CheckDate AS CheckDate, DocumentProformaInvoice.Author AS Author, DocumentProformaInvoice.ChangeDate AS ChangeDate, DocumentProformaInvoice.ChangeAuthor AS ChangeAuthor, DocumentProformaInvoice.PointInTime AS PointInTime, ISNULL(InvoiceAccounts.SumExpense, 0) AS PaidSum, CASE WHEN ISNULL(InvoiceAccounts.SumExpense, 0) <= 0 AND DocumentProformaInvoice.Hotel.AccountingDate > DocumentProformaInvoice.CheckDate AND DocumentProformaInvoice.CheckDate > DATETIME(1, 1, 1) THEN 6 WHEN ISNULL(InvoiceAccounts.SumExpense, 0) <= 0 THEN 1 WHEN ISNULL(InvoiceAccounts.SumExpense, 0) >= DocumentProformaInvoice.Sum THEN 5 WHEN ISNULL(InvoiceAccounts.SumExpense, 0) < DocumentProformaInvoice.Sum / 2 THEN 2 WHEN ISNULL(InvoiceAccounts.SumExpense, 0) = DocumentProformaInvoice.Sum / 2 THEN 3 WHEN ISNULL(InvoiceAccounts.SumExpense, 0) > DocumentProformaInvoice.Sum / 2 THEN 4 ELSE 0 END AS InvoicePayedStateIcon FROM Document.ProformaInvoice AS DocumentProformaInvoice LEFT JOIN (SELECT InvoiceAccountsTurnovers.Invoice AS Invoice, InvoiceAccountsTurnovers.SumExpense AS SumExpense FROM AccumulationRegister.InvoiceAccounts.Turnovers(, , PERIOD, GuestGroup = &qGuestGroup) AS InvoiceAccountsTurnovers) AS InvoiceAccounts ON (InvoiceAccounts.Invoice = DocumentProformaInvoice.Ref) WHERE DocumentProformaInvoice.Posted AND DocumentProformaInvoice.GuestGroup = &qGuestGroup AND DocumentProformaInvoice.GuestGroup <> VALUE(Catalog.GuestGroups.EmptyRef)
